output:
Implemented the model **item** core: `item.json` schema and helpers, host storage with KV index, CLI `model item …`, agent tool `image_studio_item`, `--item` / `item` on model generate with step input resolution, gallery `itemId`, version **0.9.0**.

### Changed paths
- `src/item.ts` — steps, Zod schema, `createItem` / `addEntry` / `selectEntry` / `nextStep` / `itemSummary` / `priceFor`, CLI parse, resolve model+concept from item
- `src/model-server.ts` — KV index helpers, attach/run file maps, post-generate item recording
- `src/model.ts` — `--item` on generate CLI; optional model/concept when item is set
- `src/generation.ts` — optional `itemId`
- `server.ts` — item read/write/index, `model item` CLI, `image_studio_item`, item-aware `runModelTextureUv` / `runModelBlueprint` (runs under `items/<item>/…`), generate + tool wiring
- `tests/item.test.ts`, `tests/item-cli.test.ts`
- `package.json` — `0.9.0`

### Verification (run here)
- `node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/item.test.ts tests/item-cli.test.ts` — pass  
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — pass  
- `node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/*.test.ts` — pass (290 tests)  
- `grep '"version": "0.9.0"' package.json` — ok  

```plan-fact
[
  {"item":1,"status":"done","evidence":["tests/item.test.ts","cmd:node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/item.test.ts tests/item-cli.test.ts"]},
  {"item":2,"status":"done","evidence":["tests/item-cli.test.ts","src/model.ts:466-545"]},
  {"item":3,"status":"done","evidence":["package.json","cmd:npx tsc --noEmit && node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/*.test.ts"]}
]
```

**APPROACH:** Pure item logic in `src/item.ts`, host/KV helpers in `src/model-server.ts`, then server wiring for CLI, tool, and generate paths with item-scoped run folders and `item.json` updates after texture-uv / blueprint.

**LESSON:** Texture/preview steps stay “not done” until an entry is explicitly selected; auto-`done` on first entry would skip the pipeline in `nextStep`.

- Full plugin backups use a versioned JSON payload (`kind: 'bb-project-folders-backup'`, version 1) containing settings and all 11 durable tables: folders, folder_paths, thread_places, folder_rules, project_rules, project_order, execution_defaults, session_policies, preferences, item_styles, and folder_archives. Imports preserve row IDs and run in one transaction; invalid backups and imports during an active move or archive are rejected. Transient tables (exports, pending_exports, project_moves, thread_moves, section_moves) are excluded. This adds no schema changes and preserves the existing appearance-only export/import flow.
- WordPress posts are always created as drafts. The publish catalog exposes only WP_*/WORDPRESS logins, site-host entries, and the currently selected entry; foreign usernames stay out of the UI.
